references.text: God promises to take Israel as His people and be their God, the same covenant formula found in Leviticus 26:12.
God promises to dwell among the children of Israel and be their God, parallel to the promise to walk among them.
The context of the verse - God will set His dwelling among them and not abhor them.
Your Lord your God walks in the midst of your camp, the same image of God's presence among His people.
The new covenant contains the same promise: I will be their God, and they shall be my people.
The covenant formula is repeated: They shall be my people, and I will be their God.
God's dwelling shall be over them, and He will be their God and they His people.
The covenant formula in Zechariah: They shall be my people, and I will be their God.
Paul quotes this text: I will dwell among them and walk among them, and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.
